sideA.text:
Have finally fully accessed the satellite towers. Starting to monitor different frequencies. Whoever is broadcasting uses multiple channels. We’ve lost a lot of time listening to these decoy stations.

Accessing the towers has given us a sense of purpose. We feel invigorated!

Immediately spend up to 3 production units on character abilities. Finish spending these before step 3 of setup (Supply the Grid).

sideB.text:
DECEMBER 19, YEAR 48

The three labs in the Southern Hemisphere have made limited advancements, but perhaps too late as PEARL has stopped reporting. Their last broadcast said they had found what they needed!

The sediment cores contained bacteria samples in which they had identified the bacteriophage. We had it! We had a means to a cure. Now they are gone. Sending a team to investigate. They are covered properly to avoid attention.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.

mechanics.whenRead: Continue the August setup Legacy-deck reading, immediately after 08-01. Resolve the production bonus before step 3 of that setup.
triggers: Before step 3 of setup (Supply the Grid): finish spending the bonus production.
rules: Immediately spend up to 3 production units on character abilities. These units are free; the card does not say to pay Supply for them.
Finish spending them before step 3 of setup (Supply the Grid).
Keep the card in the reserve.
mechanics.notes: The 3 is printed in an orange circle inside the blue rules box on the journal side (08-02a), not on the archive. A handwritten signature under the Year 48 note is not transcribed.
